english.note: Use this when emphasizing ammonia as a gas, such as in a leak or an industrial setting.

examples.english: Ammonia gas leaked at the factory, so everyone immediately put on masks and went outside.
examples.traditional: 工場漏咗氨氣，大家即刻戴口罩走出去。
